newsitem.title: USA: Investors shouldn't expect Mexico-type rescues--US.
newsitem.headline: Investors shouldn't expect Mexico-type rescues--US.

text.p: A senior U.S. official warned investors on Wednesday not to bank on future Mexico-style economic rescues by Washington.
"The United States cannot and will not be any kind of global lender of last resort," U.S. Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers told CNBC television.
He called the U.S.-led rescue of Mexico a "special situation" in which American interests were heavily involved.
Mexico announced on Wednesday that it was prepaying the emgergency loans it received from the United States under the 1995 rescue package.
